Healthcare & Cost Architecture

Healthcare & Cost Architecture

The platform had to grow beyond its on-premise hardware without putting clinical data or uptime at risk. These case studies cover the application decomposition, the device-integration tier, the analytics pipeline that took reporting load off the live database, the network and access model, and the CI/CD pipeline that ships to it.

Case studies

01 / Applications & integrationCut database read loadDecomposing an on-premise clinical monolith into containerized services, and taking reporting load off the live database with a decoupled analytics pipeline. → 02 / Applications & integrationHL7 device interoperabilityA dedicated integration tier translating proprietary medical-IoT telemetry into standardized HL7 and JSON for clinical systems and a partner hospital network. → 03 / Data & storageReal-time clinical analyticsStreaming physiological telemetry into a real-time OLAP store so care teams can query months of patient vitals without touching the operational database. → 04 / Networking & securityZero-public-ingress securityA network design where no compute or database resource has a public IP, engineering access is mutual-TLS VPN only, and the CDN is tuned for clinical apps. → 05 / Platform & deliveryRegulated CI/CD deliveryA GitFlow-to-Kubernetes pipeline with per-branch promotion gates, headless registry authentication, and deployment lead time cut from hours to minutes. →
